name: Acme
english_description: An experimental English LDMud 3.x framework by devo@eotl (2016-2017), formerly titled "untitled gamification platform." The published tree is a platform plus an acme-basic flavor (look/say/walk, rooms, containers) and an unfinished acme-rpg flavor (one combat module). No shipped game world — new characters start in The Void with a workshop to the north. Not Cloudxtreme/eotl-mudlib (a utility fragment).
